subject: MAP template & pilot acceptance — Meridian Health (initial draft)
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP template & pilot acceptance — Meridian Health (initial draft)

Hi Elena,

Great to meet last week — appreciate you walking through Meridian's pilot goals. As promised, I pulled together a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we can align on milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria before we lock dates.

What I attached/shared:
- meridian_map_v0.1.gdoc (editable) — compact MAP with recommended week-by-week milestones
- pilot-acceptance-matrix.xlsx — test cases and pass/fail thresholds we propose for the pilot
- map-lite-slides.pptx — 3-slide summary we can use with execs

Ask: can you review the acceptance criteria section (page 2 of the doc) and flag any must-have items or compliance blockers by EOD Wednesday? If that works, we'll convert the MAP to a co-editable doc and schedule a 30-min sync to confirm owners.

Suggested initial timeline (draft):
- Week 0: Kickoff & infra prep (customer infra validation)
- Week 1–2: Integration + sample data validation
- Week 3–4: End-to-end acceptance tests
- Week 5: Sign-off & transition to production pilot

If there are security or procurement constraints (e.g., specific evidence required for data handling) loop in your security owner — we'll stand up the required artifacts.

Thanks — looking forward to your notes.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: meridian_map_v0.1.gdoc (Google Doc), pilot-acceptance-matrix.xlsx (Excel), map-lite-slides.pptx (PowerPoint)

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@meridianhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: DevOps Team <devops@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP template & pilot acceptance — Meridian Health (initial draft)

Hi Markus — thanks for the quick turnaround. I scanned the doc and appreciate the condensed format. A few immediate notes: 

- Acceptance criteria: please add an explicit SLA for inference latency (95th pct) and a token-cost estimate for the sample workload. Our procurement team needs that number to evaluate spend.
- Security: our security lead will need SOC 2 evidence and architecture diagram showing VPC flow. Can you attach or point me to a SOC 2 attestation and an infra diagram?
- Timeline: we have a hard constraint — leadership wants production pilot started no later than the week of June 21. Can your timeline shrink to meet that?

I'll loop in our DevOps lead momentarily with specific infra dates. Overall — this looks promising.

Elena
VP Product | Meridian Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@meridianhealth.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP template & pilot acceptance — Meridian Health (initial draft)

Hi Elena — looping in from the implementation side. Quick answers to your asks: 

- SLA / latency: we can target 95th percentile <= 220ms for the sample prompts you shared. I'll add a line in the acceptance matrix with measurement test harness and metrics collection plan.
- Token-cost estimate: based on the 3 sample flows, estimated cost is ~ $0.004 / interaction (this is a draft; we'll refine when we have representative traffic). I'll add a cost table to the spreadsheet.
- SOC 2 & infra diagram: attaching a SOC 2 summary and a minimal architecture diagram. If you need the full attest, we can provide the report under NDA.
- Timeline compression: achievable if we parallelize infra validation and integration tasks. Proposed accelerated schedule attached to the MAP doc (Week 0 onboarding replaced by a short, focused infra sprint).

Propose a 30-min sync Thu 13 May 08:30 PT to walk the adjusted MAP and confirm owners — does that work for you?

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: SOC2-summary.pdf (stub), redwood-minimal-arch.svg (stub)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP template & pilot acceptance — Meridian Health (initial draft)

Thanks Marissa — and thanks Elena for the prompt feedback.

Elena — I updated the MAP doc and the acceptance matrix per Marissa's inputs (added SLA row, cost estimates, and links to the SOC2 summary + arch diagram). Links below:
- MAP (co-edit): https://docs.google.com/document/d/meridian-map-v0.1 (now editable by both teams)
- Slides: https://drive.google.com/file/d/map-lite-slides

I've also added a proposed compressed timeline that targets the week of June 21 for pilot start by:
- Parallel infra validation (DevOps) + SDK integration (our team) during Week 1
- Fast pass acceptance tests in Week 3

Next steps:
1) Please add or confirm owners next to each milestone in the MAP doc (column on the right).
2) Marissa & Jordan will run the test harness and share a short runbook before the sync.
3) If owners are confirmed, we'll open a DocuSign packet for the pilot SOW (I attached a placeholder SOW stub).

Confirming the sync: Thu 13 May 08:30 PT — calendar invite sent.

Best,
Markus

Attachment stubs: pilot-sow-placeholder.pdf (stub)

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@meridianhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: DevOps Team <devops@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP template & pilot acceptance — Meridian Health (initial draft)

Markus / Marissa — thanks for the edits and the compressed timeline — that looks good. A couple of small asks:

- I've updated the MAP doc with owners for infra and product review. Please confirm the owner for "integration test harness" (I tentatively put Jordan).
- Procurement still wants the token-cost estimate in a single-line summary for the SOW — can you add that to the placeholder SOW before we sign?
- We'll need a short (10–15 min) exec summary slide for our C-suite — can your slides be trimmed to one slide with key milestones and acceptance bullets?

If you can make those three small updates by EOD tomorrow we can proceed to sign and hit the June 21 target.

Elena
